event: 2014 Preseason Game 1, Tampa Bay at Jacksonville, August 8, 2014
frozen: 2014-08-07, after the final walkthrough and Stone's meeting with Cousins and Tice; before any draw
provenance: Stone's written plan of August 4, 2014 (career/2014/04_Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Preseason_Games/Game_01/Preseason Game 1_ HC.md), applied August 5 to 7 and reduced under its own rules (career/2014/04_Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md#august-7-the-reduction-call-by-call). Every call is a retained call from the active 2013 offensive book (Iteration I); nothing was installed new for this game. Opener order is carried in the 'opener' field; the kernel labels snaps uniformly from the sheet and does not condition on script order, jump rules or shot triggers, which remain in-game coaching guidance.

menus.opening_15: calls with an 'opener' index, in that order; 12 Ace Right, Power Right is calls 1 and 9 and is frozen once, as the 2013 sheets froze a duplicate, because a second row would double that label's share (a list artifact, not a football decision)
menus.third_down: third-and-short: Power, Inside Zone (Doubles), Mesh, Inside Zone + Access Bubble; third-and-medium: Mesh, Stick (Trey, with and without RETURN), Drive; third-and-long: Dagger (HALF), Y-Cross (SOLID), Mesh, RB Slow Screen against pressure
menus.backed_up: Power, Inside Zone, Outside Zone, Stick, Boot Flood when the edge is controlled
menus.red_zone: high: Y-Cross (11 and 12), Power, Counter, Drive; low: Bunch Mesh, Power, Counter, Boot Flood
menus.goal_line: Power, Counter, Power Pass only: the book permits a goal-line call only from a picture practiced at that field location, and only these were run from it this week
menus.two_minute: Spacing (with and without the shift), Stick, Drive, Mesh, RB Slow Screen; PRESS tempo with the first group and Henne's group only
menus.sudden_change: the Outside Zone / Boot Flood pair from 12 Wing, then the normal-down sheet
menus.HOLD_sequence: one sequence, the same twelve-personnel eleven: 12 Ace Right Power Right, 12 Doubles (Y flexed) Stick, 12 Wing Right Split Zone Left, no substitution
menus.PRESS_sequence: one short sequence of mastered calls by signal and word: 11 Doubles Stick SCAT, 11 Doubles Spacing SCAT, 11 Doubles Inside Zone, 11 Bunch Right Mesh HALF; first group and Henne's group only (cut for the reserve and late groups on August 7)
menus.reduced_menu_bray_shaw: Power, Inside Zone, Stick, Drive, Mesh, Boot Flood from the huddle; operation first (huddle, formation, point, cadence, decision, ball security)

units_rule: A call with no 'units' field is available to every group that takes a possession; a 'units' field restricts it. Protection defaults follow the book (quick game SCAT, five-man dropback HALF, heavy intermediate SOLID, boot NAKED) and are named only where Stone's plan names them.
notes: Script order, the return to the opener on the next appropriate normal down, the possession ceilings, the shot condition on call 15 and the first-group-only condition on call 14 are coaching guidance the kernel's call-sheet schema does not carry; they are recorded here and in rotation.json and are not conditioned on by the draw.

The information categories Stone wants from the booth after every series (defensive personnel, front, box count, safety shell, motion response, pressure, substitution response, what changed) are sideline process, not a sheet item.
Formation modifiers and motion are descriptive fields; the kernel freezes them in the canonical sheet for audit and does not model motion response.
The plan's Trap, Wham, Jet, Scissors, flea flicker and 6OL exclusions are honoured by omission; the 6OL package has also not been run in camp (Bradfield unsigned).
